title: Navimower 0.4.4-beta35

## Validate manual mowing zone IDs

This prerelease hardens `navimower.mow` against invalid explicit zone IDs before a command is sent to the mower.

- Explicit `zones` values are checked against the mower's currently known map zone IDs whenever map zones are available.
- Unknown IDs now raise a Home Assistant service validation error instead of being encoded into the vendor mowing command.
- The validation message reminds users to use Navimower's internal map zone IDs rather than a displayed zone number/name.
- Existing behavior is preserved when no explicit zones are supplied: all currently known zones are used.
- If the integration has not received any zone IDs yet, explicit IDs remain allowed for backward compatibility.
- First-generation H-series compatibility is unchanged: H500/H500E/H800/H800E/H1500/H1500E/H3000/H3000E still use mower-controlled zone ordering even when one or more valid zones are selected.
- Navimower Map Card already supplies internal IDs from the Map API, so no Map Card change is required for this fix.

This addresses the unsafe failure mode reported in issue #288, where sending a displayed zone number instead of the internal zone ID could reach an H500E and produce vendor error 6010.
